member.name: M:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.Devices.Network.NetworkController.Enable
member.summary: Brings the interface up synchronously. Blocks until the PHY/WiFi firmware is ready; for non-blocking bring-up use .
member.remarks: Multi-interface coexistence: multiple controllers (e.g. Ethernet and WiFi) may be enabled at the same time. The native lwIP wrapper registers each as its own netif and routes outbound traffic by destination netmask (longest-prefix match). For destinations not covered by any interface's subnet (e.g. public internet), the controller most recently passed to owns the route.

member.name: M:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.Devices.Network.NetworkController.EnableAsync
member.summary: Non-blocking variant of . Returns immediately while the slow PHY autonegotiation / WiFi firmware boot runs in a native RTOS task. The interface is NOT ready when this returns — subscribe to (link becomes physical-up) and (DHCP / static IP assigned) to learn when it is. Call at most once per controller per boot.
